title: Leveraging unlabeled SEM datasets with self-supervised learning for enhanced particle segmentation
mechanism: In-domain from-scratch ConvNeXt V2 FCMAE on 25k unlabelled greyscale SEM images, crops without rescaling to keep small details, beats ImageNet ConvNeXt V2 weights; DenseCL falls below ImageNet.
adaptation: Use their modified repo and settings (640 px crop without rescale -> 512 px for us, 32 px mask patches, 50% mask, checkpoint by val reconstruction loss) for the from-scratch arm on the EL pool; cut the 15,000-epoch schedule about 20x; Pico/Nano sizes only; 1-ch input.
min_experiment: Pico/Nano FCMAE from scratch on 11.9k (then 50k curated) vs ImageNet FCMAE weights of the same size in U-Net++ PF; out-of-fold relF1@2 and E1 crack recall, 2 seeds; kill if both < +0.01.
evidence: R (full text): +0.8 to +1.5 AJI+ low magnification, +1.9 to +5.9 high magnification over ImageNet at all 8 sizes, 10 repeats; best at Pico 8.6M; beat ImageNet with ~1,000 pretraining images on the easy task; 33 to 188 h on 80 A100s.
prior_overlap: none for this backbone/recipe; our closed run was continued MIM on ImageNet R34.
